creator: Peter Hanzo
method: Run scripts/jetson_track_review.py on the full clip twice from frame 1 with persistent tracking. Compare the per-frame JSONL IDs and inspect annotated frames near 242-264. Then use sparse human landmarks on two objects in benchmarks/annotations/pexels_plastic_bottle_landmarks.json. This is not a complete tracking ground truth.

observations.variant_comparison: The two runs have identical class and track-ID counts on every frame; the observed track IDs are identical frame by frame. Box coordinates vary slightly.
observations.shared_failure: IDs 1 and 7 overlap in 14 frames with box IoU 0.59-0.76, median 0.65. Human landmark points on the same large bottle are covered by both IDs in sampled frames 242, 257, and 264. This creates two first-ID proposed decisions for one observed object in either setting.
observations.second_object: A smoky green bottle with white neck has a tracked box covering its manually marked landmark in only one of nine sampled frames under either setting. This is a candidate detection/localization miss, not a general recall estimate.
observations.qualification: The landmark audit covers two objects at 21 selected frames, not every object in the clip. It cannot establish a general ID-switch rate or detector recall.

limits: The video is unlabelled and differs in framing from WaRP-D. No mAP, identity accuracy, or speed claim is derived from this review. The review script writes MP4 and does not benchmark pipeline throughput.
